answers.rationale: Record format is [CRC32:4][op:1][txn_id:8][data_len:4][data:N]; replay stops at the first record whose CRC fails to verify.

presented_options.A: all three rows — every fsynced WAL record is replayed on startup
presented_options.B: the two earliest rows — only WAL records that survive the CRC check are replayed; the trailing one is dropped

answers.rationale: WAL replay skips uncommitted transactions; without a COMMIT record the three INSERTs are treated as an uncommitted prefix and discarded, so SELECT sees no rows.
